buildRecipe.name: Scribus libs kit (sources + MSVC projects + patches + build-all-libs.bat) 20261026

residualGaps: (1) Exact dependency versions come from the Scribus libs kit scribus-1.6.x-libs-msvc-20261026.7z (date = 1.6.7 release commit aa658d92, 2026-10-26); its file list was read via HTTP range requests of the 7z header only (kit is 375 MB and was not downloaded). The kit itself contains full library sources + MSVC projects + Scribus patches (e.g. poppler-24.05.0.patch) and is the most exact corresponding source; upstream tarballs are listed per component. The kit's README/changelog/scribus-lib-paths.props sit at the end of a 230 MB solid LZMA2 block and could not be read without a full download. (2) Poppler: kit has 21.12.0 and 24.05.0; 24.05.0 chosen because Scribus.exe PE linker version is 14.29 (toolset v142) and only poppler-24.05.0 ships lib/x64-v142 - probable-to-exact. (3) Statically linked libs (lcms2, hunspell, poppler, librevenge & lib* importers, boost, pixman) have no version resource; versions come from the kit directory names. (4) Python 3.8.20 in the kit is a prebuilt binary (python-x64); CPython 3.8.20 had no official Windows binaries, so the Scribus maintainers built it - their build script is presumably in the kit (not inspected). External libs listed from CPython v3.8.20 get_externals.bat and confirmed by DLL versions (OpenSSL 1.1.1w, SQLite 3.35.5, Tcl/Tk 8.6.9). (5) Qt 5.15.19 assumed to be the unmodified open-source release (props file points to a generic F:\Libraries\Qt-5.15.19 install); Qt translations submodule source is probable. (6) Not listed: VC_redist.x64.exe 14.44 and MSVC runtime (Microsoft, no source), NSIS installer stub/plugins (zlib-licensed, no source obligation), setuptools/distlib launcher exes (from the listed pip/setuptools sdists). Bundled fonts (Lato2, URW 1.41, Vera), hunspell/hyphenation dictionaries and ICC profiles are part of the Scribus source tarball. (7) Scribus commit archive size unknown (>20 MB, dynamic).
